v.s: When the victory of God has come and the conquest,
v.c: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺,

q: ...and you see people entering the Deen of Allaah in droves
v.s: And you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes,
v.c: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds,

q: ...then glorify the praises of your Rabb
Without doubt, He is the Greatest Acceptor of repentance.
v.s: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
v.c: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
